title: Almost lost an eye
text:
Almost lost an eye. They fit but won’t stay…
These stoppers are cute and practical, however, it’s not worth losing an eye…

I have used these to cap, champagne, wine, club soda, and they fit, but they don’t stay. The first time I used it, I took the champagne from out the fridge, and the stopper popped out and hit me right below my eye. The next time I heard a loud pop it was the stopper popping out of the bottle of wine.

These things are dangerous, trust me. I am extremely light and when this thing popped out and hit me in my face, I had a bruise under my eye.
